mapper.select: SELECT COUNT( 1 ) AS invitee_count, COALESCE ( SUM( CASE WHEN l.layers = 1 THEN 1 END ), 0 ) AS valid_invitee_count, COALESCE ( SUM( CASE WHEN l.layers = 1 THEN 1 END ), 0 ) AS one_layer_invitee_count, COALESCE ( SUM( CASE WHEN l.layers = 1 AND u.activate_status = 1 THEN 1 END ), 0 ) AS one_layer_valid_invitee_count, COALESCE ( SUM( CASE WHEN l.layers != 1 THEN 1 END ), 0 ) AS other_layer_invitee_ount, COALESCE ( SUM( CASE WHEN l.layers != 1 AND u.activate_status = 1 THEN 1 END ), 0 ) AS other_layer_valid_invitee_ount, COALESCE ( SUM( w.recharge_amt ), 0 ) recharge_amt, COALESCE ( SUM( CASE WHEN l.layers = 1 THEN w.recharge_amt END ), 0 ) AS one_layer_recharge_amt, COALESCE ( SUM( CASE WHEN l.layers != 1 THEN w.recharge_amt END ), 0 ) AS other_layer_recharge_amt, COALESCE ( SUM( w.order_amt ), 0 ) order_amt, COALESCE ( SUM( CASE WHEN l.layers = 1 THEN w.order_amt END ), 0 ) AS one_layer_order_amt, COALESCE ( SUM( CASE WHEN l.layers != 1 THEN w.order_amt END ), 0 ) AS other_layer_order_amt FROM r_agent_layer l INNER JOIN s_user u ON u.id = l.user_id INNER JOIN s_wallet w ON w.user_id = u.id AND w.wallet_type = 0 WHERE l.layers <= #{param.layers} AND l.sup_user_id = #{param.userId} AND l.layer_status = 1
